notes.title: 2.1.0 update
notes.notes:
Random update! Slightly nerfed hard difficulty and added feature to update existing saves to latest balance data.

Also 30% discount that will last for couple of days is planned to start tomorrow!

Full changelog:

[h3]BALANCE[/h3]
Hard and stable hard game modes:
- Enemy damage multiplier per wave: 2.2% -> 2.1%
- Enemy additional stat multiplier per boss wave: 25% -> 22%
- Overall enemy damage multiplier: 125% -> 120%
- Boss damage multiplier: 110% -> 107%
- Health powerup drop chance multiplier: 90% -> 95%
These changes should decrease gap between normal and hard difficulties but still keep hard difficulty *hard*

Third boss:
- Healing powerup (dropped between phases) effect multiplier: 140% -> 145%

Fourth boss:
- Healing powerup (dropped between phases) effect multiplier: 175% -> 180%


[h3]OTHER[/h3]
- Added feature that allows updating balance data of existing save file to latest version. Button to perform update can be found in saved game "INFO" panel.

notes.title: 2.0.0 update changelog
notes.notes:
All changes present in 2.0.0 content update are listed below. As a reminder, changelog for 5 most recent updates is also available in game - just click version number in the bottom left corner of the screen in any menu.


[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added score multipliers to game modes. They exist on top of point bonuses for game mode difficulty and change depending on chosen game mode options

[*]New game menu: added field that displays total score multiplier for selected game mode

[*]New game menu: added field that displays amount of bonus points awarded for completing the game on selected game mode

[*]Added new game mode option: randomized boss order - causes bosses to appear in a random order. It grants 15% additional score multiplier and can be turned on in any game mode

[*]Added new game mode option: randomized boss phases - makes bosses procedurally generated by assigning them randomly chosen phases. May cause bosses to be CONSIDERABLY harder. Grants 30% additional score multiplier and can be turned on in any game mode

[*]Added new game mode: boss rush - changes default waves into 12 boss waves and enforces both new boss randomization options. Available in both standard and stable variants 

[*]Boss rush game mode also alters available consumables, perks and causes bosses to drop additional currency and energy powerups

[*]Most of the small player bullets are now more square-shaped

[*]Tweaked player bullets coloring a bit

[*]Added 2 new achievements

[*]Fixed a bug that caused short game mode to have incorrect available player unit/weapon combinations
[/list]


[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]New player weapon: Crawler - shoots pulsing bullets in a wave pattern and it's damage depends on bullet's size during hit

[*]New player weapon: Swarmer - shoots a swarm of low damage bullets that can bounce off the edges once

[*]New weapons won't appear in previously saved games, you need to start new one to try them out

[*]New enemy behavior: Charge - travels across game area while shooting. After leaving screen, waits a certain amount of time, then travels back

[*]Enemies with charge behavior travel in different patterns at higher waves

[*]Adding new enemy behavior causes enemy reshuffling in stable game modes. It means that you will encounter different set of enemies when playing an older saved game with stable game mode
[/list]


[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*]Rifle: decreased base damage from 50-70 to 45-65

[*]Tracker, Homing discharger and blue unit's barrage skill: can no longer target enemies outside of game area

[*]Slightly decreased collision radius of small player bullets

[*]Boss2: increased attack speed multiplier from 55% to 80% and adjusted cooldowns for all attacks so overall everything stays the same, but when this boss' phase is used by some other boss, it should be considerably easier

[*]Boss3: increased attack and movement speed multipliers from 100% to 130% and adjusted attack cooldowns/movement speed so overall everything stays the same, but when this boss' phase is used by some other boss, it should be considerably easier

[*]Boss3: slightly increased speed during teleporting phase
[/list]


[h1]Sound[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused background music to start playing when the game was minimized and setting which was supposed to prevent so was toggled on
[/list]


[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*]Small tweaks in Polish translation

[*]Landing screen animation can now be skipped if it was seen at least once
[/list]

notes.title: Random update #5
notes.notes:
Hi, it's time for some more news about upcoming content update and some other stuff!


[h1]Update details[/h1]
New content update is expected to go live October 23rd 2019 @ 17:00 CEST

There are 2 new gameplay trailers available in the store page. First was uploaded last week and mainly focuses on new player weapons, while second one is very fresh and shows off new [b]boss rush[/b] game mode. It can also be seen on youtube: [previewyoutube=D0IecXgFTAU;full][/previewyoutube]

The two new player weapons are:
[list]
[*] [b]swarmer[/b] which shoots multiple bullets in a swarm-like pattern. It's bullets bounce off edges of game area once before flying away. 
[*] [b]crawler[/b] which shoots single bullet that dynamically changes it's size. Damage dealt depends on bullet's size at the time of hit (almost no damage when bullet is small, very high damage when bullet is big)
[/list]

Enemies will also gain new AI pattern, but that needs to be found in game :)

On top of that there will also be three new [b]game mode options[/b]:
[list]
[*] Randomized boss order - can be turned on in any game mode for additional point multiplier, causes bosses to appear in random order
[*] Randomized boss phases - can be turned on in any game mode for additional point multiplier, causes bosses to be procedurally generated by assigning them random behavior phases, which means it's very unlikely for two boss fights to be the same
[*] Boss rush mode - entirely alters the game flow: enforces both boss randomization options, amount of waves is reduced to 12, every wave is a boss fight, causes bosses to drop currency in between phases, changes available wave skip consumables
[/list]

Point multipliers are new thing that help adjusting amount of points gained to how difficult the game is. The idea is that toggling on certain game mode options increases total point multiplier. For now only boss randomization and changing rng seed after defeat grant additional point multipliers.


[h1]Version naming[/h1]
With the new content update, the game's version will be changed to 2.0.0. Why ?

I decided to use convention where version number is a combination of 3 numbers separated by dot. In short it's composed like that: xxx.yyy.zzz. Changes to specific number inform about severity of changes:
[list]
[*]xxx - major patch which includes sizable amount of new content or system changes, smaller changes and bugfixes
[*]yyy - minor patch which includes very little content or system changes, few smaller changes and some bugfixes
[*]zzz - bugfix patch which does not contain any content or system changes, has one or two smaller changes and is mainly focused on bugfixes
[/list]

Upcoming patch has quite a lot of new content and system changes, therefore I consider it as a major patch, which means the leftmost number will be increased - 2.0.0.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
First patch is here!

This one is very small, but brings few bugfixes and a new quality of life feature: ability to save custom game modes. Check it out in action here:

https://imgur.com/a/v3L0jf8

Game modes are saved in JSON format, which means they can be easily edited in any text editor (although it's neither advised nor supported - do it at your own risk as you might break stuff !). They should be located in
[i]C:/Users/[Username]/AppData/LocalLow/PN/JustRandomSquares/CustomGameModes/[/i] directory

Patch notes can also be found in game - just click on version number in bottom left corner.


[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added ability to save custom game modes so they can be used without the need of adjusting everything all over again

[*] Saved custom game modes are not being saved in cloud (might be changed in future patches)

[*] Fixed a bug in new game menu that caused sound to not be played when selecting game mode for the first time

[*] Pressing menu cancel button (escape) in achievements and leaderboard menu now causes return to main menu
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tweaked Polish localization a bit

[*] Changelog text can now be selected and copied
[/list]

notes.title: Random update #2
notes.notes:
Hello again!

It's time for another update about current state of development.


[h1]Current build[/h1]

Current build of the game was approved by Steam, so at this point there is virtually nothing that prevents me from releasing the game. That said, I still want to spend next couple of days on playtesting to find potential problems/crashes/bugs, so no release for now, but I am almost certain I will be able to provide specific release date by the end of this week. (which should be within next 2 weeks range anyway)


[h1]Controller support[/h1]

There won't be controller support, but also there will be. What ?

First of all, I feel that this type of game is less than ideal to play with controller, so I didn't plan to add controller support of any sort. Second thing is technical aspect of adding controller support. In short, the game is made in Unity and it's default input solution makes it impossible to rebind keys during the game, so I had to wrap it with my custom solution which makes it possible to rebind keys, but was made without any controller support in mind, so it would be somewhat problematic to work around it right now.

However, this is where Steam Input comes into play, which makes it possible to control every game using controller. To test this feature, I dug up my 15+ years old 5$ controller manufactured by an unknown asian company (I personally dislike using anything but keyboard + mouse for gaming). After a bit of tinkering with controller settings in Steam big screen I was able to bind all keys used by game to controller buttons, which allowed me to successfully launch the game and even beat few waves of squares with it. I also made a somewhat usable default preset so controller is somewhat usable just out of the box.

TL;DR: No controller support built into the game, but it's possible to play the game using controller thanks to Steam Input 


[h1]Why no early access ?[/h1]

There are couple of reasons for releasing the game as a final product instead of as an early access title. First, I personally dislike it when games hide behind early access tag for months/years when they are feature rich and good enough to be treated as a fully released product. Second, I [b]might[/b] continue expanding the game with content patches, but no guarantee there. Of course I will do my best to fix any bugs/problems that might show up after the release, but new content depends on game performance and player engagement. Third reason is just my overall feeling about whole idea of early access. Nowadays, it feels like early access tag is just a way to say "we want your money right now but our game is unfinished and bugged, so please don't mind that, it might get better some day", which doesn't sit right with me. When I buy a product, I get it in a state it is at this point of time, no matter if it's early access / beta / full release or whatever else, so slapping tag like that doesn't really matter for me.


[h1]Cinematic trailer[/h1]

I thought about it and decided I won't be doing one. This is just a little game and time spent creating hype up video can be allocated to more useful things. Also I personally never watch cinematic trailers because they give me no information about the game whatsoever. I would rather watch a few minutes of gameplay to get a general idea what the game is about than 30 seconds of video to build up hype that tells me nothing. That said I plan to record another short gameplay video which includes first boss fight and upload it by the end of this week or early next week.

notes.title: Random update #1
notes.notes:
Hi!

Work on the game continues and release comes closer and closer. I have vague date in mind, but I don't want to reveal it before I'm sure the game is actually ready. 

Here are some of the things I'm working on right now:
[list]
[*] Steamworks integration - achievements and cloud saves (right now these features are mainly done, but still need testing)
[*] Playtesting to make sure the game is stable and is as bug free as possible
[*] Balancing stuff so you can actually beat the game (I've actually beaten the game once already on normal difficulty. It took me 178 defeats which is kind of high number, but then I'm not very skilled when it comes to bullet hell games)
[*] Finding typos in texts
[*] Finishing background music 
[*] Adding random features that require not-that-much effort, but I suddenly feel like adding (such as recently added option to disable scaling of in-game ui on higher resolutions, so it's not stretched to fill the window and instead black bars appear)
[/list]

There are also things I consider implementing before release, but I might aswell patch them in at some point in the future, or even entirely skip them:
[list]
[*] Some kind of system to save/share custom game presets so they can be easily reused later. Right now there are "hardcoded" game modes that differ in difficulty and other settings + there is custom game mode that lets you tweak all available settings. Right now if you want to start another playthrough using custom mode similar to the one you used before, you have to tweak all the options all over again remembering all the values, which isn't very convenient, but does the job.
[*] More mechanics when it comes to bullets/weapons
[*] Maybe some kind of randomized player unit - right now there are 5 "classes" of units you can choose from, each one has predetermined skills and stats. I'm thinking here about adding some kind of "wildcard" unit which has randomized stats/skills each time it is available.
[/list]

I've put a fair amount of hours into developing this project, but I realise it's not AAA high production value game. It's just my first game (and I am mainly a programmer), so I had to acknowledge it will be rough around the edges, especially when it comes to art and graphics. Asking $50 for the game may be fine for AAA studios, but not for some random guy making his first game. I believe in fair (and square) pricing, so I think [b]cost of this game should be around $6.99[/b] before applying steam regional pricing suggestions.

If there are any questions, feel free to make a post in discussions section here https://steamcommunity.com/app/1109880/discussions/, tweet me at https://twitter.com/JRSGame, or just make a comment below - I will try my best to answer.
